name: Harmonious Bells adds exactly 4 more targets to Mercy (#2446)
contract: Harmonious Bells 704917 (SpellFamilyName 33) is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS (17), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 bit 0x20, matching Mercy's (504848) own SpellFamilyFlags_1 0x20 and its own EffectChainTarget_1 6. Shipped EffectBasePoints_1 is 4; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves that to a real value of 5 (basePoints + 1, DieSides 1) -- one more than the quoted 'Your Mercy now affects 4 additional allies'. Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets adds the raw modifier value straight onto Mercy's own ChainTarget, so the talent's own contribution to the extra-target count equals the modifier's real value regardless of Mercy's baseline (6 -> 6+mod), the same relationship Everglow's own +2 on Radiant Cascade and Radiant Cascade's own tooltip ('jumps to up to 4 additional allies' for its native ChainTarget of 4) both confirm for this class's wording convention: the modifier's value is the tooltip's 'additional' count, 1:1. ApplyAscensionSunClericRadianceContracts patches EffectBasePoints_1 down by one at load time so CalcValue returns exactly 4, making Mercy's modified target count 6+4=10. The 'spell_modifier' query metric calls the same native Player::ApplySpellMod(504848, SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS, base) path Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets uses, without casting Mercy.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Mercy keeps its own 6 chain targets
Harmonious Bells adds exactly 4 more, for 10 chain targets total
